design.endpoint: five-drug normalized AUC, not dose curves
design.split_rule: SHA256 canonical source organoid ID: <60 train, <80 validation, else test
design.donor_rule: PDAC only, one sample per patient confirmed in Supplementary Data 1
design.feature_rule: top 1000 variance after log2(FPKM+1), selected on GPU using training donors only

limitations: AUC loses curve shape and cannot fulfill the dose-level endpoint.
Publisher sample-per-patient metadata is not independent identity revalidation.
Published inspected development data; no untouched confirmation claim.
